messages:
nina-sre: Planned control-plane rolling restart next Wed 2026-05-06 03:00-04:00 UTC. Purpose: apply controller-manager patches and kubelet hotfix. Expected: brief control-plane API latency blips during leader elections; data-plane serving should be uninterrupted but some control APIs (deploy, scale) may return 5xx for short bursts.

tom-ops: We'll do canary on a single zone first (us-central1-a) and only continue if control API p99 < 500ms and error rate < 0.2% for 10m.

li-platform: Note: dedicated clusters tagged SLA=true are excluded from automated restarts. If a team needs their cluster included, open an ops-exceptions ticket with justification.

ara-eng: I'll enable the maintenance flag in config so SDKs show a warning banner for 1h; adding a short status page note.

cs-lead: Please notify CS and Support 48h before. Customers with reserved capacity should be emailed.

nina-sre: Rollback criteria: control-plane p99 > 700ms sustained 5m OR api-server 5xx > 0.5% absolute. If triggered, abort and run immediate leader failback plan.

tom-ops: Preflight checklist snippet:
```
kubectl get componentstatuses && kubectl get nodes -o wide
# snapshot apiserver metrics
curl -s http://metrics.internal:9090/api/v1/query?query='histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(apiserver_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))'
```

rotations-bot: oncall: tom-ops assigned for 02:30-04:30 UTC. Reminder 24h prior.

nina-sre: TL;DR: control-plane rolling restart 2026-05-06 03:00-04:00 UTC; canary zone -> stagger; Dedicated SLA=true clusters exempt; rollback if p99>700ms >5m or 5xx>0.5%. React with :white_check_mark: when covered.
